original_text:
[Source PDF page 15]
Social media sites use a distributed system where the data is stored in many countries.
In the European Union, Argentina, and the Philippines the right to be forgotten has
been established as law. The right to be forgotten means a person has the right to have
private information removed from databases and applications so it cannot be found in an
internet search.
(c) Discuss the impact of the decentralized web on an individual’s right to privacy. [6]
